NPDES PERMIT NO. AK-0034521

SECTION 3. EFFLUENT LIMITATIONS FOR OUTFALL 001

For five-day biochemical oxygen demand (BOD5), the monthly average limit shall not exceed 25 mg/L. The daily maximum limit for BOD5 shall not exceed 40 mg/L. For total suspended solids (TSS), the monthly average limit shall not exceed 30 mg/L. The daily maximum limit for TSS shall not exceed 45 mg/L.

The pH of the effluent shall be maintained within the range of 6.5 to 8.5 standard units at all times. Dissolved oxygen in the effluent shall not be less than 5.0 mg/L at any time.

Effluent temperature is subject to seasonal limits. During the winter monitoring period, the discharge temperature shall not exceed 4.0 degrees Celsius. During the summer monitoring period, the discharge temperature shall not exceed 20.0 degrees Celsius. The discharge temperature shall not fall below -1.5 degrees Celsius at any time during the winter monitoring period.

Fecal coliform bacteria shall not exceed a monthly geometric mean of 200 colony-forming units per 100 mL. The daily maximum for fecal coliform bacteria shall not exceed 400 CFU/100 mL.

Total residual chlorine shall not exceed a daily maximum of 0.5 mg/L. The monthly average limit for total residual chlorine shall not exceed 0.2 mg/L.

Discharge flow from Outfall 001 shall not exceed a monthly average of 2.1 MGD. The daily maximum discharge flow shall not exceed 3.0 MGD. Measured in metric units, the monthly average discharge flow shall not exceed 7949 cubic metres per day.
